question: Which kernel prevents the current matched A/B control implementation from reaching the long-context memory-hierarchy regime?
answer: MULTIPLE_KERNELS: score and context kernels both scale superlinearly (observed exponents ~2.5 and ~2.1 over 1K->16K). Full-width softmax is NEGLIGIBLE (flat 0.006-0.069 ms across all lengths, 0.01% of 16K total) and is NOT a barrier.

evidence_basis.note_16k: 16K run completed all timed phases and wrote its summary before the driver killed the process at the 86 C policy limit; its data is retained with that caveat.
evidence_basis.note_32k: No per-kernel 32K data. Only external reference: P1 single-iteration probe medians A 644.398 ms / B 724.988 ms.
evidence_basis.candidate_mechanism_from_source_inspecti: physical_block() loads the ENTIRE block table (N/16 i32 entries) as a tile on every call, then extracts one entry. It is called once per score tile (N tiles -> O(N^2) aggregate table traffic) and once per serial context iteration (16 heads x N/16 iterations -> O(N^2), all on the serial critical path). Softmax never touches the table, consistent with its measured flatness. This mechanism is source-derived and timing-consistent but not yet counter-verified.
evidence_basis.score_classification: DOMINANT at longest safe length (70-71% share at 16K; steepest scaling ~N^2.5)

recommended_repairs.name: Single-entry block-table lookup
recommended_repairs.description: Replace the per-call full-table tile load in physical_block() (load_tile of all N/16 entries + extract) with a single-entry lookup (1-element tile or scalar gather of table[logical]). Applied symmetrically to the A (full_kv_baseline) and B (model_profile) kernel pairs.
recommended_repairs.semantics: Preserved exactly. Same table values, same indirection results; expected bitwise-identical outputs relative to A0/B0.
recommended_repairs.evidence: Removes the only N-dependent per-work-unit cost identified in score and context sources; consistent with measured superlinear exponents and with softmax's flatness (softmax has no table access).
recommended_repairs.expected_research_value: HIGH: restores approximately O(N) scaling for both dominant kernels; 16K pipeline expected to fall from ~90 ms toward low single-digit ms, making the cache-residency crossover region safely measurable.
recommended_repairs.engineering_risk: LOW: one helper function per module; launch grids, tile shapes and arithmetic unchanged.

recommended_repairs.name: Parallel context reduction (Candidate B)
recommended_repairs.description: Two-stage context: stage 1 grid (query_head, sequence_chunk) accumulates partial weighted sums over contiguous logical-block chunks; stage 2 reduces chunk partials per query head. For B, the latent partial sums ([32]) are reduced first, then the unchanged output projection is applied once.
recommended_repairs.semantics: Preserved within normal floating-point ordering differences (FP32 accumulation associativity changes only).
recommended_repairs.evidence: Context still launches only 16 blocks (8.33% occupancy at 1K, P0.5) and serializes N/16 iterations; after R-TABLE this serial O(N) chain becomes the residual long-context barrier.
recommended_repairs.expected_research_value: MEDIUM-HIGH: unlocks lengths beyond ~16K-32K for the crossover study; limited value at <=16K if R-TABLE already restores near-linear timing.
recommended_repairs.engineering_risk: MEDIUM: extra transient partial buffers, second kernel launch, correctness revalidation for both paths.

recommended_repairs.name: Hierarchical exact softmax (Candidate A) - NOT RECOMMENDED
recommended_repairs.description: Deliberately not recommended. Measurement shows full-width compile-time softmax is NEGLIGIBLE at every tested length (0.01% of 16K total). Implementing Candidate A would add complexity and thermal cost without removing any measured barrier.
recommended_repairs.engineering_risk: Would risk disturbing the validated control for no measurable gain.

symmetry_requirement: A0 (original full KV) and B0 (original latent) must remain runnable and unmodified. Repairs produce A1/B1 variants only. Never optimize only the latent path.
